## What this lands

- **`resolution/src/resolution/partner_name_packet.py`** — the
  committed OP-15 disposition packet generator
  (`sig.partner-name-disposition-packet/1`). `build_packet` turns a
  `partner-name-audit` report into the measured packet: N
  (`legacy_keys`), keep/split counts, scoped-candidate total, distinct
  asserting sources, the split-count histogram, and the **OP-15 option
  blast radii** (`keep` = single-source keys; `split` = multi-source
  keys + scoped candidates; `same_as` honestly `sized:false` — this
  query carries no strong-id joinability, never an invented count).
  `build_queued_packet` emits the `prepared_not_executed` packet a
  queued run commits — same query + digest surface, `n`/`measured`
  null, nothing fabricated. **SIG-ENG-042 fail-loud:** a 0-key report
  is refused (`--allow-empty` is the recorded escape); an inconsistent
  report is refused. **Part VIII:** per-key rows are `entity_id` +
  `name_key_sha256` + counts only — no registrant name, label or free
  text reaches a committed artifact.
- **CLI** (`resolution/src/resolution/cli.py`) —
  `partner-name-audit` gains `--dsn-env` (env-only DSN — never argv),
  `--role` (`SET ROLE sig_read_public` inside the read-only
  transaction) and `--out`; new verb `partner-name-packet`
  (`--report`/`--queued`, `--started-at`/`--finished-at` or
  `--planned-at` — `date -u` bounds required, never invented).
- **`ops/gcp/partner-name-audit.sh`** — the scripted/recorded
  invocation: `--check` prints the offline plan (`check OK`, no
  ADC/network); `--apply` gates on project + ADC + env DSN (exit 3),
  drives cloud-sql-proxy → the read-only audit → the packet
  generator, recording `date -u` bounds and the packet sha256 for the
  ledger.
- **The committed packets**
  (`docs/build/reports/p35.21-partner-name-audit/`) — the queued
  `prepared_not_executed` packet (query + `query_sha256` already
  pinned, re-run prompt verbatim, `n` null) and the `fixture-spine/`
  measured packet (3 keys, 1 splitting → 5 scoped candidates) as the
  generator's worked example — labelled fixture evidence, never a
  hosted count.
- **Tests** — `tests/resolution/test_partner_name_packet.py` (12
  tests: counts, OP-15 radii, digest binding, Part VIII boundary,
  vacuous-N + inconsistent-report refusals, queued packet fabricates
  nothing); `partner-name-audit.sh` registered in the IaC
  parse/credential/check-mode lists.
